arguments.command:
cd /workspace && export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD/native" PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps"; python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,math
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from te.session import _controller_route,_controller_admit
random.seed(1)
mxprod=0;mxstat=0;mxs=0
for it in range(200000):
 E=random.randint(1,64)
 rho=random.choice([1,2,3,5,8])
 vals=[random.uniform(-1e7,1e7) for _ in range(E)]
 live=list(range(E))
 z,t,h=_controller_route(vals,live,E,rho)
 V={e:vals[e] for e in live}
 for e in live:
  # should z=min(V,h)
  exp=min(V[e],h)
  if abs(z[e]-exp)>1e-7*(1+max(abs(z[e]),abs(exp))): print('z wrong',it,e,z[e],exp,h);raise SystemExit
  st=rho*(z[e]-V[e])+t[e]
  mxstat=max(mxstat,abs(st))
  if abs(st)>1e-7+1e-7*max(abs(rho*z[e]),abs(rho*V[e]),abs(t[e])):
   print('stat fail',it,st,rho,z[e],V[e],t[e],h);raise SystemExit
  comp=t[e]*(h-z[e]);mxprod=max(mxprod,abs(comp))
  if abs(comp)>1e-7: print('comp fail',it,comp,t[e],h-z[e],h,z[e]);raise SystemExit
 ss=sum(t)
 mxs=max(mxs,abs(1-ss))
 if ss>1+1e-7: print('sum fail');raise SystemExit
 if abs(h*(1-ss))>1e-7:
  print('hc fail',it,h,ss,1-ss,h*(1-ss),vals,rho);raise SystemExit
print('route all ok maxprod',mxprod,'maxstat',mxstat,'max1-sum',mxs)
PY
